summary: Iteration 5 (i18n/l10n infrastructure) fully validated. 7/7 new backend tests + 33/33 regression from iters 1-4 passed. Full frontend i18n propagation confirmed via Playwright: PT default → Brasil switch (Definições) → save+reload → BR labels/currency propagate to Clients, Financial, Orçamentos → reset to PT → currency and address labels revert. Sidebar/design unchanged.

issues: Preview text 'Pré-visualização: 1234,50 €' uses the currently-saved module locale (from format.js). After selecting a different country in the dropdown but BEFORE clicking Guardar, the preview still shows the OLD currency (e.g. R$ after previous BR save, even when Portugal is selected in the form). Minor UX: preview does not react to unsaved form changes; it only updates after save+reload. Not a functional bug — save-then-reload flow is by design.

action_items: (Optional, minor UX) Make Definições preview line reactive to the current unsaved form state (use form.currency/form.locale instead of module eur()) so the user sees the new currency immediately before saving.

(Low, carry-over from iter 4) Add DialogDescription to remaining dialogs (Financial invoice, Clients 'Novo cliente') to silence the persistent Radix a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1200 lines with the new Settings model + endpoints. Still overdue to split into routers/{settings,clients,quotes,contracts,invoices,galleries,ai,public}.py + models.py.

Settings model uses `dict` for address_labels without a nested Pydantic model. This works but does not validate structure: a caller could PUT {"address_labels": {"foo":"bar"}} and it would be persisted. Consider a nested AddressLabels(BaseModel) with 4 required fields (postal_code, region, city, district) for stronger validation.

Client model keeps both `nif` (legacy) and `tax_id` (new) with no migration/aliasing. Existing seed data has `nif` populated but `tax_id` empty; the UI now only reads `tax_id`. Consider a one-time seed data migration or a Pydantic validator that back-fills tax_id from nif when tax_id is empty, so historical clients still display a document number under the new i18n label.

SettingsProvider (lib/settings.jsx) renders null while loading. On the initial page open, this delays any UI render until the /api/settings round-trip completes (~100-400ms). Acceptable but could show a splash instead.

Definições `save` performs `window.location.reload()` after PUT — a hard reload works but loses in-flight React state. A cleaner approach is to call reload() from SettingsProvider (already implemented) and rely on components subscribing via useSettings. Current implementation double-does the work: SettingsProvider.reload() + full page reload.

format.js keeps a module-scoped `current` object. Not thread-safe in SSR (though CRA is client-only). And Definições' preview reads from `eur()` = money() = module `current` — meaning the preview line does not update as the user edits the form (only after save+reload). Consider computing the preview from form.currency+form.locale directly with Intl.NumberFormat.
COUNTRIES.BR.tax_label = 'Imposto' (generic). In practice Brazil uses ISS/ICMS/PIS/COFINS depending on service type. Preset is safe but low-fidelity. Fine for i18n infra scaffold.
GET /api/settings creates the default doc lazily inside a GET (side-effect on read). Idempotent and harmless, but semantically odd. Prefer initializing on startup or on first PUT.
